definitions.meaning: A lid, covering, roof, an inclosure, a vault

quotations.english: I know all the roofs of the high heavens

quotations.old_english: Ðonne bearn Godes þurh heofona gehleodu óþýweþ
quotations.english: when the son of God shall appear through heaven's vaults

source_text: ge-hlid, es; pl. nom. acc. -hlidu, -hleodu; n. A lid, covering, roof, an inclosure, a vault; tectum, claus&u-long;ra, septum :-- Ic cann ealle heáh-heofona gehlidu I know all the roofs of the high heavens, Cd. 27; Th. 37, 3; Gen. 584 : Exon. 15 a; Th. 32, 25; Cri. 518. Ðonne bearn Godes þurh heofona gehleodu óþýweþ when the son of God shall appear through heaven's vaults, 21 a; Th. 56, 23; Cri, 905.
